limits: English lexical cues in the explicitly English rule-evidence disclosure are not checked by the German scanner.
Catalogue prompts are instructions, not executed semantic checks. Twelve rules have no lexical detector.

Contextual review covered product introductions, headings, instructions, examples, tool boundaries and selected risky modifiers in research records. It did not revalidate every paper, benchmark price or translation against an independent bilingual reviewer.
Guide prose, SEO metadata, browser layout and live deployment are separate checks. Source hashes record the reviewed inputs; further edits require another scan.
